method: Actual menu/race/countdown, 20 seconds autonomous RCCP driving with explicit public gearbox up/down commands, pause and scene return. Per-rendered-frame source/HUD telemetry; separate Play-only cloned-chassis PhysX contact fixture. Does not measure speaker latency or subjective sound quality.
checks: Menu music is scheduled; UI uses its own mixer route and one slider attenuation. Synthetic same-frame Confirm/Purchase dispatches only Purchase.
Normal Menu to track01 quick-race flow emits exactly three countdown cues and one GO with four participants.
Per-rendered-frame CSV verifies rising/falling RPM and shifts: actual TMP labels, audio source pitch and HUD share one powertrain sample.
Twenty seconds of real RCCP autonomous input produces speed, shifts and engine/road voices; player and opponents suppress the legacy engine path.
Synthetic cue probe during an actual race pause suppresses Wrong Way and allows Back on the UI source.
Controlled Play-only cloned chassis: 3cm drop produces an actual PhysX contact and a positive impact voice below the old800Ns gate.
Controlled Play-only cloned chassis sliding at an initial8m/s activates sustained asphalt scrape audio from real CollisionStay contacts.
Stopping the controlled contact fixture fades the scrape, leaves no contact voices and does not spam impacts.
Returning to Menu restores music and leaves no racing engine loops.
